metadata.source_note: Minimal contract for a local-only DRAW_CARDS -> DEAL_DAMAGE bridge with explicit wording gate and no parser/lowering/runtime expansion.

bridge_kind.label: draw_cards -> deal_damage
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable strict local closure where explicit draw trigger wording co-exists with explicit local deal-damage payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile.

activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit wording equivalent to 'Whenever you draw a card, [this card] deals 1 damage to any target.' in the same local sentence.
honesty_constraints: Do not infer bridge from isolated draw text without explicit deal-damage wording.
Do not infer bridge from isolated deal-damage text without explicit draw trigger wording.
Do not activate on draw-second-card wording.
Do not infer across adjacent draw payoff families.
